name: Brisk Teaching
description: The Brisk Teaching connector brings your classroom toolkit into Claude. Create interactive student activities, quizzes, standards-aligned lessons, and more right in the tools you already use. Just describe what you need, and Brisk builds it in your account with easy-to-share links, so you can turn your ideas into classroom-ready materials in seconds. Edit, refine, and bring them to your students whenever you're ready.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brisk Teaching to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brisk Teaching to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.briskteaching.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brisk Teaching MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brisk Teaching provides these MCP tools: create_teaching_resource, create_boost_activity, generate_next_ideas, create_batch_feedback_assignment, list_standards, get_boost_activity, get_teacher_context, finalize_boost_activity, and get_teaching_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brisk Teaching?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brisk Teaching in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.

_published_faq.name: Does Brisk Teaching MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brisk Teaching requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brisk Teaching is developed by Brisk Teaching. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
